fusions.name: Tail Like a Maul
fusions.desc: Brings your tail down on the target with a blow that deals 34 damage, ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ground Thump
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Flattened in Return
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it lasts restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Settled Weight
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and you regenerate 0.4 health a second.
